database.note: Hand-written DDL only. Never drizzle-kit push. All tables use cm2_ prefix to avoid conflicts with V4.7 marketplace_ tables.

public.note: Always filters moderation_state='approved' AND is_active=true. fileUrl never returned. Unauthenticated POST /rate was removed — use workspace route instead.

removedEndpoints.reason: Remediation P0: customerEmail from request body was source of truth for ownership identity. Ratings now only accepted through workspace token-authenticated route.

workspace.auth: workspace token via resolveWorkspaceSession — falls under PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES exception
workspace.note: All queries scoped to session.clientEmail — IDOR protected.

routerMount.instruction: Team 24 must import cm2Router and register it in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts
routerMount.position: After creativeMarketplaceRouter (V4.7) — no ordering constraint otherwise

pages.description: Browse/search/filter marketplace — public, no auth needed
Listing detail, preview, license info, ratings
Workspace favorites — requires workspace token in URL or query
Admin listing management — CRUD, moderate, feature
Moderation queue — pending listings for review

security.fileUrlNeverPublic: fileUrl column is excluded in toPublicDTO(). All public endpoints call getListingPublic() which delegates to dbGetListingPublic — only approved+active listings.
security.emailMasking: Customer email masked in public rating DTOs (jo***@domain.com).
security.idor: Workspace routes resolve session from token via resolveWorkspaceSession; all queries scoped to session.clientEmail.
security.moderationGate: Pending/rejected/suspended listings are invisible on all public routes.
security.noPayoutImpl: No automatic payout or subscription logic. Payment reuse via adapters only.
security.noNewSubscriptions: Domain never creates subscription records or payment intents.
security.ownershipIdentityRule: No endpoint accepts customerEmail from body/query as ownership source of truth. Workspace routes derive identity from token. Public download recording allows nullable anonymous email — not a security gate.

remediationNotes.P0_fixed: Removed POST /public/cm2/listings/:id/rate — unauthenticated rating submission allowed identity spoofing via body email.
remediationNotes.P1_perf_fixed_1: getFavorites() replaced N+1 loop with single JOIN query (dbGetFavoritesWithListings).
remediationNotes.P1_perf_fixed_2: GET /public/cm2/categories replaced full 200-row scan with dedicated SELECT DISTINCT category SQL query.
remediationNotes.P1_rating_guard: submitRating() now uses Number.isFinite() guard to reject NaN/Infinity in addition to range check.
remediationNotes.P2_tests_added: Added 16 new tests: malformed payload, NaN/Infinity rating, pagination pass-through, cross-customer IDOR (getFavorites/removeFavorite/getCustomerDownloads), public rate removal documentation.

conflicts.withV47: Completely separate tables (cm2_* vs marketplace_*). Routes use /cm2/ prefix vs /creative-marketplace/ prefix. No shared DB writes.
conflicts.withPhase8: Phase 8 AI Skills marketplace is at /marketplace/* — no overlap.
